title: Mariah Carey defrosted as a punk

scenes.say: Mariah Carey just defrosted for Christmas. But this year, she came back as a punk.
Every November first, she drops her famous 'It's time' video.
scenes.heading: EVERY YEAR

scenes.say: Fans joke that she's been frozen in ice all year, and count down to the thaw.
scenes.label: according to the internet

scenes.say: But this year: a red wig, fishnets, and dark lipstick.
scenes.heading: THIS YEAR

scenes.say: And it opens with a rock song almost nobody had ever heard.
scenes.heading: THE SONG

scenes.say: Why? It's from a secret band she had in the nineties. She only admitted it in her memoir.
scenes.heading: THE TWIST
